An Allo agent picks up and puts you through to sales or support. It is the fastest demo on this page.

Solo is $10 a seat a month, billed yearly. Business is $32 a seat a month billed yearly, or $45 month to month. Ultra is $100 a seat a month, through sales. One number per seat and free porting are in the price, with no setup fee. Two things are add-ons you switch on when you need them: the AI receptionist at $32 a month per agent, and the power dialer at $50 a month for the whole team. There is no long contract either: you cancel whenever you like, and the first 30 days are money-back. See the full pricing , or what a text costs by country .
Does it work with my CRM?

Yes. Allo syncs natively with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Attio, GoHighLevel, Odoo and Google Sheets, and reaches everything else through Zapier, Make or the open API on Business and above. Calls, summaries, tags and texts land on the right record on their own, so nobody types a call into a CRM again. Browse every integration , or connect Allo to Claude and your other AI clients .
Can I try it first, and how hard is the setup?

There is a 7-day free trial. You leave a card on file and it is only charged on day 7. Setup is guided and you do it yourself, no technical skills involved, and most teams are taking calls on Allo the same day. If you would rather hand it over, our team will set the whole thing up for you for a one-time fee.
What does the AI receptionist actually do?

It answers when nobody on your team can, asks the caller what they need, books straight into your calendar, texts back the calls you miss, and writes every call into your CRM. It's an add-on at $32 a month per agent, and it hands the call to a person the moment it needs one. Today it answers calls, it does not place them. How the AI receptionist works , and what it does after the call .
How does it work with several people?

Every seat comes with its own number, and you add or remove people whenever you like with no seat minimum. The team shares the same call history, the same tags and the same texts, so whoever picks up next can see what happened last time. You decide who rings and in what order: call routing , ringing everyone at once or one after another , and a phone menu if you want callers to choose. Questions about a call stay on the call itself , not in a separate chat.
Can I keep my current number?

Yes, and porting is free in both directions. It takes a few business days and there is no downtime: you keep taking calls on your current service right up to the moment the number switches over. What porting needs from you . If you would rather keep your current line and add one, a second number works too.
